pages.title: Swift Crossbow
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r IV$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Crossbow$(br2)§lEffect: §r Bolts deal extra armor-ignoring magic damage: I +2, II +4, III +6, IV +8. Reload time is reduced: I -0.25s, II -0.5s, III -1.0s, IV nearly instant.$(br2)§lConflicts: §r Mutually exclusive with Quick Charge.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table, Loot Chests, Villager Trades
